verified: Flying (kw.line); If ~ would deal combat damage to a player, instead put that many +1/+1 counters on ~ and that player mills that many cards (rep.edhv84.self.combatDamageToPlayer.instead.counters.mill: a damage replacement of this creature's combat damage to a player, `instead` putting as many +1/+1 counters on it as the damage and milling the damaged player as many cards, CR 614.1a, 510.2, 122.1, 701.17; the player is the event's recipient, the number the event's amount). Ruling 2005-10-01 read: another effect that prevents or replaces the damage is chosen first by that player (the replacement pipeline, CR 616.1).

Vigilance (kw.line); As ~ enters, look at an opponent's hand, then choose any card name (rep.stdrx6.enters.lookHand.choose.cardName, link cardName); Spells your opponents cast with the chosen name cost {2} more to cast (sta.edhv84.spells.opp.chosenName.more: costMod of spells with the chosen name, caster opponent, +{2} generic, CR 601.2f, 118.7); Activated abilities of sources with the chosen name cost {2} more to activate unless they're mana abilities (sta.edhv84.abilities.chosenName.more.exceptMana: abilities of sources of that name in every zone, caster any, exceptMana, CR 602.2b, 605.1a). Rulings 2022-09-09 read: any card name; the last ability affects cards in every zone; mana abilities and triggered abilities are untouched; the taxes apply to every opponent (spells) and to every player (abilities).

Flying (kw.line); As ~ enters, each opponent reveals their hand. You choose the name of a nonland card revealed this way (rep.edhv84.enters.revealHands.choose.nonlandName: every opponent's hand shown to all players, one name chosen by you among the nonland cards revealed, none revealed: none chosen, CR 614.12a, 701.20a, 201.3); Your opponents can't cast spells with the chosen name (sta.stdrx21.player.cantCast.filter, read once parse.ts#faceChoices links the name: restriction on each opponent casting a spell of that name, on each opponent casting a spell of that name, CR 601.3, 607.2d). Rulings 2015-06-22 read: one name, not one per opponent; no nonland card revealed: no name and no restriction; permanent cards of that name can still be put onto the battlefield; a face-down cast is allowed.

Suspend 6--{W} (kw.line); Each player chooses a number of lands they control equal to the number of lands controlled by the player who controls the fewest, then sacrifices the rest (eff.edhv84.balance.lands: op balance of lands) and Players sacrifice creatures and discard cards the same way (rid.edhv84.balance.creaturesThenCards: parts lands, creatures, cards in this order, CR 608.2e, 701.21a, 701.9a). Rulings 2021-03-19 read: choices in APNAP order, the lands sacrificed together, then creatures, then cards in hand discarded; triggers wait until it has resolved.

{4}{W}, {T}, Sacrifice ~: Each player chooses a number of lands they control equal to the number of lands controlled by the player who controls the fewest, then sacrifices the rest (eff.edhv84.balance.lands) and Players discard cards and sacrifice creatures the same way (rid.edhv84.balance.cardsThenCreatures: parts lands, cards, creatures, CR 608.2e, 701.21a, 701.9a). Rulings 2018-07-13 read: APNAP choices, simultaneous sacrifice per kind, a player with none makes everyone else lose all of that kind.

{G}{W}{U}, {T}: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn (eff.rep.fog). Activate only before the combat damage step (the activation restriction `turnOf` any turn, every step up to the declare blockers step: untap, upkeep, draw, first main, beginning of combat, declare attackers, declare blockers, CR 602.5b, 506.1, 510.4; the first strike damage step is a combat damage step, so it is not in the list; render alt in render/abil.ts#onlyIfWords, reading parser/lower/activation.ts#DURING_ANY). No Scryfall rulings.

Ward {2} (kw.line); {3}{U}{U}: ~ can't be blocked this turn (eff.rst.cant.beblocked). Activate only if you own a card in exile (the announcement condition `exists` of a card in exile owned by you, parser/holes/edhv84.ts: a card in exile has an owner, not a controller, CR 406.1, 108.3, 602.5b). No Scryfall rulings.

When ~ enters, destroy target non-Elf creature an opponent controls with power X or less, where X is the number of lands you control (trg.enters, eff.p2cs2.effects.whereX, eff.destroy; the target filter's power is at most the number of lands you control, read when the target is chosen and again on resolution, CR 608.2b, render alt np.ts power-x-or-less-where-x); Winnowing Forces's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control (sta.cda.pt). Defense and the Siege rules are the engine's. Rulings 2023-04-14 read: Siege rules only.
